# Rober González - Personal Portfolio

> Single-page personal site for Rober González, Senior Software Designer focused on AI native products, working across product design, web design and data visualization. Based in Spain, working remotely.

The site is a single typographic page: a short first-person introduction where key terms (roles, disciplines, employers, clients, links) are set as inline badges. Outbound links show a small preview card on hover. It has light and dark themes that follow the system setting by default and can be switched manually.

## About Rober

- Senior Software Designer focused on AI native products, based in Spain, working remotely.
- Works across product design, web design and data visualization, from research to frontend code.
- Currently at Maisa AI, shaping how people work alongside Digital Workers.
- Fifteen years before that across startups (Fresh People), agencies (Populate) and enterprise (NTT Data), for clients like Santander, IAG, Acciona and Airbus.

- [Maisa AI](https://maisa.ai): Current employer, an AI software company.

## Technical Notes

- Stack: Vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no frontend framework and no build step.
- Self-hosted fonts and inlined icons: the page loads with no third-party requests.
- Full content is in the HTML and renders without JavaScript.
- Reduced-motion support via `prefers-reduced-motion`.
